title: Account center and admin APIs
objective: Account center APIs (profile, preferences, security state, passkeys/MFA/linked identities via IdentityAdmin, sessions, account deletion workflow with policy hook) and system admin APIs (users, organisations, roles, audit, jobs, providers, system) with independent authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Admin API tests: non-admin and org-admin denied; MFA-required enforced for system admin when configured
Account deletion requires confirmation + recent authentication and blocks sole-owner deletion (tests)
